# Ujjwal Srivastava

> B2B Content Strategist, Head of Content at Magnaitic, GEO/AEO architect, and ghostwriter for founders. Based in India.

Ujjwal Srivastava is a Head of Content and B2B SaaS content strategist specialising in GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), semantic entity mapping, and editorial leadership. He ghostwrites for startup founders and executive leaders, producing LinkedIn long-form content, thought leadership essays, and founder-voice articles.

## Services
- B2B Content Strategy
- GEO / AEO Architecture
- Founder Ghostwriting
- Content Audits
- Editorial Leadership
- AI Citation Optimisation
- Semantic Entity Mapping
- Writer Training SOPs
